name: M1126 ICV Stryker
representative_system: M1126 ICV Stryker — Wheeled armored fighting vehicle
characteristics: Strength: Wheeled mobility gives higher road speed and lower maintenance burden than tracked IFVs; multiple mission variants share one chassis
Limitation: Wheeled platform has less cross-country capability than tracked IFVs in mud/off-road conditions common on the front
Estimated quantity available: Delivered as part of a wider announced package; exact totals not fully disclosed
employment_notes: Part of a wider Stryker family donation (ICV, reconnaissance, medical evacuation, and 105mm gun-armed MGS variants each separately cataloged) giving Ukraine a flexible wheeled fleet
contrast_vs_traditional: Stryker's whole design case was road-mobility — wheeled speed to outrun a threat and reach the objective before it could react. That same predictable road movement is precisely what standoff drone reconnaissance watches for: the doctrine.md finding that detection is a multi-day pattern-of-life problem applies as much to vehicle routes as to launch-team positions, so the speed that once meant survivability now also means visibility.

notes: Rests only on tertiary reference works; wants a primary or trade source.
